about.title: About Cropto
about.body: Cropto is a prototype platform for trading and risk management of commodity-linked instruments. It combines on-chain settlement with off-chain index price feeds. Instruments are cash-settled against the Spike Spot Index (CPT Odesa) and do not involve physical delivery.

how.title: How the Marketplace Works

how.step2: Connect your wallet to authenticate (MetaMask supported).
how.step3: Create or take orders for options or spot/forward instruments.
how.step4: Track margin and settlement. P&L is settled in CROPT based on the index price.

keyConcepts.title: Key Concepts
keyConcepts.lead: Cropto separates price risk from physical grain flows so logistics and supply chains are not distorted by speculation.
keyConcepts.bullet2: Market risk can be hedged without forcing physical delivery.
keyConcepts.bullet3: Physical grain moves when it’s optimal for the supply chain, not for trading timing.
keyConcepts.bullet4: Blockchain is used where it adds value: rules, audit trails, and transparency.

farmer.title: For Farmers
farmer.body: Farmers can manage price risk without guessing the “best sale moment”. You trade the price index, while physical logistics stays a separate decision.

trader.title: For Traders
trader.body: Traders get an instrument to trade real commodity price indices and run arbitrage across local and global markets without disrupting physical deliveries.

web3.title: For Web3 / Crypto
web3.body: Cropto uses blockchain for trust and verification: transparent rules and immutable audit trails. This is infrastructure for real commodities, not crypto speculation.

indicesSpot.title: Indices & Spot Tokens
indicesSpot.lead: Indices are reference prices for specific markets. Spot tokens represent price exposure for demo trading — they do not represent ownership of physical grain.
indicesSpot.bullet1: Each index is defined by region, commodity, and basis (e.g., CPT Odesa).
indicesSpot.bullet2: Quotes are typically shown in USD per ton and updated as new market data arrives.
indicesSpot.bullet3: Spot tokens let you take directional exposure (long/short) without dealing with physical delivery logistics.
indicesSpot.bullet4: P&L is calculated from index prices and settled in CROPT in the demo environment.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Practical answers about demo access, wallets, settlement, and data.

q1.question: Is Cropto a live trading platform?
q1.answer: No. Cropto is a prototype demo environment for testing and partner presentations. Functionality and results are provided “as is” and may change.

q2.question: Do trades involve physical delivery of grain?
q2.answer: No. Instruments are index-linked and cash-settled. There is no physical delivery.

q3.question: What is CROPT?
q3.answer: CROPT is the demo settlement and accounting unit used on the platform (e.g., margin, P&L, settlement).

q4.question: Why do I need a wallet to use Cropto?
q4.answer: A wallet is used to authenticate and sign actions in the demo flow. It helps keep an audit trail for testing.

q5.question: I see “read-only mode” for a country — what does it mean?
q5.answer: Market data may be visible, but trading is enabled only for selected regions in this build. Use UA if you want to test the full trading flow.

q6.question: How are settlement and P&L calculated?
q6.answer: P&L is calculated from index prices according to the instrument rules (e.g., strike, expiry, quantity) and settled in CROPT in the demo environment.

q7.question: What is margin and when can a margin call happen?
q7.answer: Margin is collateral reserved to cover potential obligations. A margin call may occur if required collateral increases or available collateral becomes insufficient.

q8.question: Are there fees in the demo?
q8.answer: If fees apply in a given flow, they are shown in the interface before you confirm actions.

q9.question: Where does market data come from?
q9.answer: Index values may be provided via integrated feeds or entered for demo/testing. Availability depends on the selected region and build configuration.

q10.question: What personal data is stored?
q10.answer: We may store account identifiers (e.g., email, user ID) and technical/usage data needed for testing, support, and audit trails. We do not use data for marketing without consent.

q11.question: How can I report an issue or request access?
q11.answer: Use the Feedback section in the navigation or contact the Cropto team via the project’s designated channel. Include steps to reproduce and screenshots when possible.

q12.question: Can features or rules change over time?
q12.answer: Yes. Cropto is under active development. UI text, flows, and calculations may be updated between builds.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: Cropto is a prototype platform for trading and risk-management of commodity-linked instruments. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and protect personal data of users who access or test the platform.

list.technical: Technical data (IP address, browser type, device information, log files).
list.usage: Usage data (visited pages, interactions with trading and analytics modules). During development data may be stored with third-party infrastructure providers (hosting, databases, analytics).

legal.title: Legal Basis and Purpose of Processing

list.demoAccess: Providing access to demo functionality of the platform.
list.support: Support, debugging, and enhancement of the service.
list.compliance: Compliance with regulatory requirements, where applicable.

legal.note: Personal data is not used for marketing communications without separate consent.

sharing.title: Data Sharing and Transfers
sharing.body: Access to data is limited to authorized Cropto personnel and partners involved in development and support of the platform. Data is not sold or transferred to third parties for their own marketing purposes.

security.title: Data Security and Retention
security.body: Data is protected by technical and organizational measures. Retention is limited to the period necessary for development and testing, after which data may be anonymized or deleted.

rights.title: User Rights
rights.body: Users may request access, correction, or deletion of their data by contacting the Cropto team at the designated contact address.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this policy periodically. The current version is always available on this page.

settlement.title: Payment Terms and Settlement
settlement.body: Cropto instruments are quoted and settled in CROPT and are index-settled (cash-settled) against the Spike Spot Index (CPT Odesa). There is no physical delivery of commodities. Forward-style CROPT contracts remain in development (WIP); references are descriptive only.

identifiers.title: Use of Emails and Identifiers
identifiers.body: We use email addresses, user IDs, and wallet identifiers to operate the platform: processing option actions, sending notifications (e.g., margin calls, settlements), and keeping audit trails. We do not sell or share these identifiers for marketing.

scope.title: Scope and Acceptance
scope.body: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the Cropto prototype platform. By accessing the site or using the functionality, you confirm your agreement with these Terms.

nonProduction.title: Non-Production Environment
nonProduction.body: The platform is provided “as is” solely for demonstration and testing purposes. It is not a licensed trading venue, broker, or financial advisor.

noAdvice.title: No Investment Advice
noAdvice.body: Any information, prices, indexes, analytics, or simulated trades are informational and educational only and do not constitute individual investment advice.

list.noAbuse: Do not perform actions that compromise the security or stability of the platform.
list.demoOnly: Use the platform solely within testing and demonstration purposes.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: All rights to code, design, logos, indexes, and related materials belong to Cropto or its licensors. Any unauthorized copying or use is prohibited.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Cropto is not liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from use or inability to use the platform, including quote errors, delays, outages, or data loss.

payment.title: Payment Terms and Settlement
payment.body: Platform amounts are quoted and settled in CROPT. Instruments are index-linked and cash-settled against the Spike Spot Index (CPT Odesa). There is no physical delivery of commodities and no post-delivery obligations. Forward-style CROPT contracts are non-deliverable; any references are descriptive and not a commitment to provide physical settlement.

product.title: Product Description
product.body: Cropto options are index-settled, cash-settled contracts on grain indices (e.g., Spike Spot CPT Odesa). Settlement uses index prices; there is no physical grain delivery and no after-delivery risk.

spotForward.title: Spot-Forward Market
spotForward.body: Forward contracts on the platform are non-deliverable (cash-settled) forwards on grain indexes such as Corn, Wheat 11.5, Feed Wheat, Soy GMO, and Sunflower processing. Settlement occurs in CROPT versus the Spike Spot index (CPT Odesa) with the formula: PnL = (SettlementPrice – ContractPrice) × Quantity. Positions use margin (initial margin plus margin calls), and overdue margin can be auto-liquidated. The legal force is an electronic agreement inside the platform, not a GAFTA-style physical delivery contract; disputes are handled off-chain without built-in arbitration.

fees.title: Fees
fees.body: Matching and settlement fees apply per side for forward trades: matching_fee = 0.125 CROPT/ton and settlement_fee = 0.125 CROPT/ton. With both sides paying both fees, the platform earns 0.50 CROPT/ton in total on a completed forward trade. Applicable fees are shown in the interface before you confirm actions.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The platform is a demo/non-regulated environment provided “as is”. No warranties are given. Products are for educational/testing purposes and do not constitute investment advice or a licensed trading venue. Use at your own risk.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
governingLaw.body: Relationships may be subject to the law of a jurisdiction selected by Cropto. Specific jurisdiction and dispute resolution procedures may be defined in individual agreements with partners.

general.title: General Risk Warning
general.body: Transactions with derivatives on agricultural commodities, price indexes, and other derivative instruments carry a high level of risk. Significant price fluctuations and total loss of invested funds are possible.

market.title: Market and Liquidity Risks
market.body: Prices for grains and oilseeds depend on weather, logistics, regulatory constraints, and other factors. Certain instruments may lack sufficient liquidity.

counterparty.title: Counterparty and Operational Risks
counterparty.body: In real trading there may be risks of counterparty default, technical failures, and accounting or settlement errors. The current Cropto version models such processes in a test environment.

performance.title: No Guarantee of Performance
performance.body: Historical data, simulated scenarios, and charts do not guarantee similar results in the future.

demo.title: Demo Environment Disclaimer
demo.body: The current Cropto version is intended for prototyping and testing. Any displayed trades and metrics are conditional and do not create legally binding obligations or rights.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about the Cropto platform and crypto options trading

q1.question: What is Cropto?
q1.answer: Cropto is a prototype platform for trading and risk management of commodity-linked instruments. It uses price indexes and cash settlement (in CROPT) and does not involve physical delivery of grain.

q2.question: How do I create an option?

steps.3: Fill in the option details (title, strike price, quantity, premium, expiry)
steps.4: Submit the form — the option will be created with OPEN status

q3.question: What is the matching process?
q3.answer: Matching connects the two sides of an option trade. In the demo flow, an option starts in OPEN status and becomes FILLED after a counterparty is assigned. Once matched, the contract can be exercised according to its rules.

q4.question: How does NFT minting work?
q4.answer: After an option is FILLED or EXERCISED, the owner can mint it as an NFT (ERC-721) on the supported test network. The NFT contains option metadata and can be viewed in a block explorer. Each option can be minted only once.

q5.question: What are margin calls?
q5.answer: Margin calls occur when the collateral value of an option position falls below the required threshold. The system automatically monitors positions and issues margin calls when needed. Users can top up their collateral to meet the margin requirement or the position may be force-settled.

q6.question: What are the different user roles?

roles.farmer: Can create and trade options, exercise positions
roles.trader: Can trade options and participate in the marketplace
roles.broker: Admin role with access to matching, reconciliation, and index management

q7.question: Which blockchain does Cropto use?
q7.answer: Cropto uses the Polygon Amoy testnet for on-chain features. This includes:

features.1: CROPT ERC-20 token for platform currency
features.2: CroptOptionNFT ERC-721 contract for tokenizing options
features.3: All transactions can be viewed on PolygonScan

q8.question: How do I connect my wallet?
q8.answer: You can connect your wallet in two ways:

methods.metamask: MetaMask: Click "Connect Web3" and approve the connection in MetaMask
methods.manual: Manual: Enter your Ethereum address directly in the wallet input field

q8.note: Make sure you're on the Polygon Amoy testnet for on-chain features.

q9.question: How do I track my portfolio?
q9.answer: The Portfolio page shows your complete position overview including:

features.1: Total positions and P&L across all options
